name: Shin NOZOKI-ma ~Gesshukuya Kanshi 24 Ji~
source:
The protagonist of this story is a professional peeper—the “NOZOKI Demon.”
After a twist of fate, he ends up moving into a rundown boarding house.
But as it turns out, the place is filled with beautiful women.
And to make things even more interesting, there are mysterious peepholes everywhere!

Five stunning women live in the boarding house.
Their relationships are strangely tense, and it seems to stem from the secrets each of them is hiding…
The protagonist’s goal? To uncover their secrets, dominate their bodies and minds, and have his way with them!

Peep into their private lives!
Expose their secrets!
Grab hold of their weaknesses!
And then… play with their bodies to your heart’s content!

The boarding house is a tangled web of messy relationships and chaotic sex lives…
Peep away, indulge your desires, and let it all out!

translation:
这个故事的主角是职业窥视者——“野佐木恶魔”。
命运的转折之后，他最终搬进了一间破旧的寄宿屋。
但事实证明，这个地方到处都是美女。
更有趣的是，到处都有神秘的窥视孔！

寄宿处住着五位漂亮的女人。
他们的关系异常紧张，似乎源于他们各自隐藏的秘密……
主角的目标？揭开他们的秘密，主宰他们的身心，为所欲为！

窥探他们的私生活！
揭露他们的秘密！
抓住他们的弱点！
然后……尽情地玩弄他们的身体！

寄宿处是一张由混乱的人际关系和混乱的性生活组成的错综复杂的网络……
窥视远方，放纵你的欲望，然后把它全部释放出来！
